title: Count file lines reference solution
answer:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(int argc, char **argv) { if(argc!=2) return 2; FILE *f=fopen(argv[1],"r"); if(!f) return 1; unsigned long lines=0; int ch; while((ch=fgetc(f))!=EOF) if(ch=='\n') ++lines; if(ferror(f)) { fclose(f); return 1; } if(fclose(f)==EOF) return 1; printf("%lu\n",lines); return 0; }
